audience: NBFC seller CFO, treasurer, business head and operations lead
corePromise: Test, improve and prepare an admitted loan portfolio before incurring full buyer-diligence and execution cost.

slides.title: Prepare the book before the buyer process begins
slides.purpose: Position AssureRail as staged preparation and controlled execution infrastructure for conventional direct assignment.
slides.proof: Automated Initial Assessment, expert-reviewed Portfolio Preparation, structured buyer review and coordinated closing.
slides.visual: Four-stage rail from admitted records to closing
claims: No guaranteed sale, price, timing or buyer approval.

slides.title: Subscale books lose time before they reach a bank decision
slides.purpose: Show the CFO problem: fragmented tapes, missing evidence, repeated questions, duplicated advisers and books below many conventional execution thresholds.
claims: Do not state that every market provider has a ₹150–200 crore legal minimum; describe it as a common practical focus and validate in each sales conversation.

slides.title: Five compatible sellers can prepare one analytical cohort
slides.purpose: Use the 5 × ₹10–12 crore EV example to show common schema, cut-off, remaining-tenor band, evidence standard and buyer pack.
slides.visual: Five seller lanes into a ₹50–60 crore analytical cohort, retaining seller-specific ownership, price, representations and settlement.
claims: The cohort is not legal commingling and does not erase seller-specific rights or obligations.

slides.title: Every admitted loan receives a recorded rule outcome
slides.purpose: Differentiate full-population computation from unexplained sampling.
slides.visual: 100% computational outcomes beside separately labelled CA, legal, field and technical samples
claims: Full-population does not mean every fact is independently verified or every file receives a separate legal opinion.

slides.title: Initial Assessment finds avoidable failure early
slides.purpose: Explain the paid, automated, unsigned first stage and what the seller receives.
slides.visual: Inputs → reconciliation → evidence gaps → risk/economics → remediation plan
claims: No consultant, qualified expert or human merit reviewer at Initial Assessment.
Three automated same-scope reassessments within 30 days.

slides.title: Fix the gaps and compare the next run
slides.purpose: Show affected loan–borrower pairs, owners, required evidence, corrected versions and resolved/continuing/new gaps.
claims: The workspace remains open; changed scope is requoted.

slides.title: Qualified review begins only when the seller proceeds
slides.purpose: Separate automated assessment from Portfolio Preparation with CA/financial and transaction-counsel section review.
slides.visual: Stage gate with reviewer signatures by section
claims: Asset, field or technical specialists are added only where the evidence or rule requires them.

slides.title: Buyer requirements shape preparation before formal diligence
slides.purpose: Explain post-MSA buyer profiles, record-level checks and traceable questions without implying purchase commitment.
slides.visual: Buyer criteria → policy checks → exceptions → buyer pack
claims: The buyer retains credit, legal, compliance, valuation, pricing and purchase decisions.

slides.title: A staged commercial model limits wasted spend
slides.purpose: Show the standard fixed-stage mechanics and quote variables.
slides.visual: Standard route table: committed ₹500/pair + ₹250/linked, ₹8L minimum; standalone ₹650/pair + ₹325/linked, ₹10.4L minimum; Initial Assessment 30% of standalone quote; applicable GST separate.
claims: Counts use unique seller–loan–borrower/co-borrower pairs and separate unique loan–linked-party pairs.
Every count or corpus variance is recalculated.

slides.title: Execution fees follow successful settled consideration
slides.purpose: Explain the seller-specific cumulative marginal schedule.
slides.visual: 40 bps through ₹25 crore; 30 bps marginal above ₹25 crore; ₹5L per-seller minimum; standalone premium conversion credit where eligible.
claims: No successful close, no execution success fee.
Actual seller share of purchase consideration settled is the fee base.

slides.title: Limited design-partner economics for the first two NBFC sellers
slides.purpose: Present the founder-approved offer without creating a second card.
slides.visual: Standard quote → 30% entity-bound lifetime invoice credit → discounted taxable fee
claims: Subject to signed scope, independent approval and written eligible-fee schedule.
Additional services, pass-throughs, connectivity, monitoring and contractor rates remain outside the current offer unless the quote states otherwise.

slides.title: Additional services are selected and priced separately
slides.purpose: Remove Bronze/Silver/Gold coercion and show check-box services.
slides.visual: Escrow/VAN coordination, counsel, CA certificate, bureau, registry, RTO/field work, SFTP, API and monitoring selection grid
claims: Routine managed services use published AssureRail customer rates; statutory and exceptional actual-cost items remain visible.

slides.title: Settlement remains with the appointed bank or provider
slides.purpose: Show seller-authorised distribution, debt release, service-fee leg, external charges and seller net.
slides.visual: Balanced seller-specific waterfall with VAN and acknowledgements
claims: AssureRail does not receive gross purchase consideration or unilaterally release funds.

slides.title: Compare DA with the funding alternative using your own inputs
slides.purpose: Frame immediate liquidity/risk transfer against retained-spread borrowing economics.
slides.visual: Editable CFO table: purchase price, debt release, all fees, external costs, retained exposure, annual funding cost and future spread surrendered
claims: Do not present an assumed all-inclusive 1.5% competitor route as fact.
Do not claim savings without a line-by-line comparable quote and seller-specific assumptions.

slides.title: Start with a paid scope and an honest data pack
slides.purpose: Close with the seller action: declare book, counts, corpus, asset family, remaining tenor and evidence state.
slides.visual: Five-item readiness checklist and application CTA
claims: Commercial contracting and paid processing begin only after AssureRail Private Limited and live-readiness gates are complete.
